excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
We setup a sepolia shadow fork today and played around with some BLS changes on lodestar and prysm pre-capella. As expected, the change submitted to prysm makes it into everyone else' pool (since prysm gossips the changes).

However, the interesting part is that even after a few epochs have passed, lodestar still keeps the now invalid changes in its pool, since the changes on prysm got included in the block. I guess lodestar needs to re-evaluate what's in its local pool once changes have been made on chain and empty its pool?
